scope: Read-only current-worktree revalidation of retained 15 October worker and edge coverage. Hash computations and inventory/report comparisons only; no tests or coverage execution.

reproduction.instructions: Run the following Python source, or load this JSON and exec its reproduction.python field. It prints the current audit without modifying files.
reproduction.python:
import json, pathlib, hashlib, subprocess
base = pathlib.Path('docs/testing-evidence/design-v2')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
worker = json.loads((base / 'worker-parallel-manifest.json').read_text())
edge = json.loads((base / 'edge-parallel-evidence.json').read_text())
snapshot = json.loads((base / 'friends-stats-final-ci-source-snapshot.json').read_text())['sourceHashes']
groups = {
 'workerProduction': worker['sourceHashes'],
 'workerTestsAndHelper': worker['testHashes'],
 'workerReports': worker['final']['reportHashes'],
 'edgeProduction': {e['path']: e['sha256'] for e in edge['coverage']['sources']},
 'edgeTestsAndHelper': {e['path']: e['sha256'] for e in edge['testSources']},
 'edgeReports': {e['path']: e['sha256'] for e in edge['reports']},
 'combinedCiInputs': {p: h for p,h in snapshot.items() if p.startswith(('services/sync-service/', 'supabase/functions/')) or p in ['scripts/design-v2-source-inventory.mjs', 'scripts/run-application-coverage.mjs', 'scripts/report-worker-v8-coverage.mjs', 'scripts/report-edge-v8-coverage.mjs', 'scripts/check-application-coverage-inventory.mjs', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json']}
}
checks = {name: {p: {'expectedSha256': h, 'actualSha256': sha(p), 'matches': sha(p) == h} for p,h in entries.items()} for name,entries in groups.items()}
node = "import {productionSourceInventory} from './scripts/design-v2-source-inventory.mjs'; console.log(JSON.stringify(productionSourceInventory()));"
inventory = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['node', '--input-type=module', '-e', node], text=True))
suites = {}
for suite in ['worker', 'edge']:
 retained = json.loads(pathlib.Path(f'coverage/{suite}/source-inventory.json').read_text())
 report = json.loads(pathlib.Path(f'coverage/{suite}/coverage-summary.json').read_text())
 raw = json.loads(pathlib.Path(f'coverage/{suite}/coverage-final.json').read_text())
 sources = inventory[suite]['sources']
 reported = [str(pathlib.Path(p).relative_to(pathlib.Path.cwd())) for p in report if p != 'total']
 suites[suite] = {'productionSourceCount': len(sources), 'sources': sources, 'inventoryMatchesIncludingExclusions': inventory[suite] == retained, 'missingSources': sorted(set(sources)-set(reported)), 'extraReportedSources': sorted(set(reported)-set(sources)), 'rawMapFileCount': len(raw), 'rawDenominators': {'statements': sum(len(v['s']) for v in raw.values()), 'functions': sum(len(v['f']) for v in raw.values()), 'branches': sum(sum(len(x) for x in v['b'].values()) for v in raw.values())}, 'metrics': report['total'], 'exclusions': inventory[suite]['exclusions']}
result = {'hashChecks': checks, 'checkedCounts': {name: len(entries) for name,entries in checks.items()}, 'allCheckedHashesMatch': all(c['matches'] for entries in checks.values() for c in entries.values()), 'suites': suites}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
